map.→ 打开航站楼（容量/安检）评估工具: -> Open the terminal (capacity / security screening) evaluation tool
map.为什么算出来总不够用？: Why does it always turn out to be insufficient?
map.容量和吞吐量有什么区别？: What is the difference between capacity and throughput?
map.容量是理论上限（资源×单资源处理能力），吞吐量是实际通过量，受流程、人员熟练度、: Capacity is the theoretical ceiling (resources x processing capacity per resource), while throughput is the actual amount passing through, which is usually below capacity because of process, staff familiarity and passenger behaviour. When assessing, take the minimum across the bottleneck resources and leave headroom.
map.常因只算了硬件（柜台数）没算单点处理时间，或未考虑值机—安检—登机的串行等待。建: It often happens because only the hardware (number of counters) was counted without the processing time per point, or because the serial waiting of check-in, security screening and boarding was ignored. Compute the ceiling of each link separately and take the minimum, then add queueing buffer.
map.找出瓶颈资源（如安检通道不足），指导增开通道或调整排班。: Identify the bottleneck resource (such as insufficient security screening lanes) to guide opening more lanes or adjusting staffing.
map.新建或改扩建航站楼时，按总面积、安检通道、值机柜台、登机口数，估算高峰小时可服务: When building or expanding a terminal, estimate the peak-hour serviceable passenger ceiling from the total area, number of security lanes, check-in counters and boarding gates.
map.由坡度角求机动载荷因数: Derive the dynamic load factor from the slope angle
map.由速度与转弯半径求向心加速度: Derive the centripetal acceleration from speed and turn radius
map.给定高峰小时旅客数，反算需要的安检/值机资源，做人员与设备预算。: Given the peak-hour passenger numbers, work backwards to the security and check-in resources needed and budget staff and equipment.
map.输入航站楼面积、安检通道数等参数，评估旅客处理容量与安检通过能力，辅助机场运营与: Enter terminal area, number of security lanes and other parameters to assess passenger processing capacity and screening throughput, supporting airport operations and resource allocation.
map.：总面积 40000 m²、安检通道 12 条、值机柜台 40 个、登机口 25: : total area 40,000 m2, 12 security lanes, 40 check-in counters, 25 boarding gates and 6000 peak-hour passengers. If one security lane processes 150 people per hour, the screening ceiling is 12 x 150 = 1800 people per hour, well below the passenger volume, so screening is the bottleneck and more lanes or off-peak scheduling are needed.
